summary: Backend (6/6 pytest passing) and Frontend (all key flows) tested for Billing & Inventory MVP. All features work: seeded products/customers, product CRUD, invoice creation with GST math (₹300 subtotal → CGST 27 + SGST 27 = ₹354), stock auto-deduct on save, stock restore on delete, insufficient-stock 400, overstock warning + disabled save, 3-copy print view with Original/Duplicate/Triplicate labels and print button, live Total Summary, dashboard stats and low-stock alerts.

minor.issue: _next_invoice_no uses count_documents+1 which can produce duplicate invoice_no after deletions or with concurrent requests. Consider using an atomic counter collection (findAndModify $inc).

critical_code_review_comments: Invoice numbering (server.py:_next_invoice_no) is not concurrency-safe and can collide after invoice deletion. Move to atomic counter document.
MongoDB Motor client is initialized at module import; fine for dev but consider startup event and connection pooling settings for prod.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 6 products and 3 customers via /api/seed and startup hook (idempotent). Tests created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py exists at /app/backend/tests/. Frontend uses data-testid attributes matching the spec: customer-select, line-product-select-0, line-qty-input-0, summary-*, save-bill-btn, overstock-warning, print-btn. Print page opens in new tab via window.open.
